subject: Quality Assurance & Testing
title: Legal Requirements Worldwide
description: A short lesson to help you apply Legal Requirements Worldwide.

hook.text: A US company expands to Europe. Different accessibility laws apply, with different deadlines and penalties.

buildup.text: The ADA covers the US. The EAA covers Europe. Section 508 covers US federal agencies. Each has distinct rules.

discovery.text: Despite different laws, most reference WCAG 2.1 AA as the technical standard. Compliance overlaps significantly.

twist.text: Some laws have no grace period. Non-compliance triggers fines or lawsuits immediately upon enforcement.

climax.text: Meeting WCAG 2.1 AA satisfies most global laws simultaneously. One standard, multiple compliance targets.

punchline.text: Laws differ by country. WCAG AA satisfies most of them.

quiz.question: What do most accessibility laws reference as their technical standard?
